fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-12-23 (morning, 09:35): A certificate carrying the details of the complainant was allegedly altered and submitted to obtain a benefit worth Rs. 50,000. Indhu Sri approached Tiruppur South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000243. Vasanth Mani (9000000382), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Bharath Selvam, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000273, in connection with the events. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Certificate allegedly altered and submitted with an application.
fields.Keywords: fake certificate, forgery, morning, mobile number, associate, college road, suspect
